## Equations
### EQ-H — Kinetically constrained spin-s Hamiltonian

*Defines the exact sparse and blocked-MPS quantum dynamics and the level-statistics operator.*

$$
H=\Omega\sum_i\mathcal P S_i^x\mathcal P,\quad \langle n+1|S^x|n\rangle=\tfrac12\sqrt{(2s-n)(n+1)}
$$

status: `verified` · source: main Eq. (1); main text immediately below Eq. (1)

Numerical form:

```
Enumerate periodic configurations with no adjacent nonzero occupations for exact diagonalization, or pair physical sites into the exact constrained block basis |00>,|01>,|10> for paper-scale MPS evolution; apply the spin flip only when both neighbours are zero.
```

Code: `src/scar_tdvp/constrained.py`, `src/scar_tdvp/fig2_tdmrg.py::blocked_bond_hamiltonian`


### EQ-MPS — Normalized projected coherent-state MPS

*Provides a source-independent way to evaluate the variational state and tangent vectors.*

$$
|\psi(\boldsymbol\theta)\rangle=\mathrm{Tr}(A_1\cdots A_L),\quad A_i=\begin{pmatrix}P_i|\theta_i\rangle&Q_i|\theta_i\rangle\\|0\rangle_i&0\end{pmatrix}
$$

status: `verified` · source: main Eqs. (2)-(3); Supplement I

Numerical form:

```
For occupation n, use amplitude (-i)^n sqrt(C(2s,n)) cos(theta/2)^(2s-n) sin(theta/2)^n in the 2x2 physical MPS matrix and normalize the finite ring explicitly.
```

### EQ-FLOW — Two-site TDVP flow

*Generates the phase portraits and undeformed periodic orbits.*

$$
\dot\theta_e=f(\theta_e,\theta_o),\quad f(x,y)=\Omega[1-c_x^{4s-2}+c_x^{4s-2}c_y^{2s}+2s\,s_x c_x^{6s-1}\tan(y/2)]
$$

status: `verified` · source: main Eq. (4); Supplement II, Equations of motion

Numerical form:

```
Evaluate paired odd/even RHS with Omega=1; split integration at coordinate singularities rather than changing the physical state.
```

Code: `src/scar_tdvp/tdvp.py`


### EQ-GAMMA — Intensive TDVP leakage

*Quantifies how rapidly exact motion leaves the variational manifold.*

$$
\gamma=\|iH|\psi\rangle+\dot\theta_e|\partial_e\psi\rangle+\dot\theta_o|\partial_o\psi\rangle\|/\sqrt L
$$

status: `verified` · source: main Eq. (5); Supplement Eq. (S error) and Error calculation

Numerical form:

```
Construct normalized finite-ring MPS and analytic tangent vectors, apply the independently built constrained Hamiltonian, and take the Euclidean residual norm divided by sqrt(L).
```

Code: `src/scar_tdvp/tdvp.py`, `src/scar_tdvp/constrained.py`


### EQ-R — Adjacent-gap ratio

*Tests the crossover from Poisson to GOE level statistics.*

$$
r=\langle\min(s_n,s_{n-1})/\max(s_n,s_{n-1})\rangle,\quad s_n=E_{n+1}-E_n
$$

status: `verified` · source: main Fig. 2(a) caption

Numerical form:

```

$$

### MTH-T2 — Translation-by-two orbit basis

*Makes reduced exact product-state dynamics fit in local memory without changing the quantum model.*

$$
For an orbit alpha of size p_alpha, |alpha>=p_alpha^{-1/2} sum_{x in alpha}|x>; a transition sum A from one representative alpha to orbit beta gives H_{beta,alpha}=sqrt(p_alpha/p_beta) A.
$$

### MTH-BLOCK-TDMRG — Exact pair blocking and finite-MPS time evolution

*Provides the scalable paper-scale path for the periodic L=30 six-site and one-site entropies in Main Fig. 2(b,c).*

$$
In the pair basis |00>,|01>,|10>, H=sum_j[X_right(j) P_left(j+1)+P_right(j) X_left(j+1)]; on the invariant globally constrained subspace the periodic sum is exactly the physical PXP ring, and a symmetric product formula evolves an MPS with controlled time-step and bond-dimension refinements.
$$

status: `verified` · source: Main Eq. (1); Main Fig. 2(b,c) caption

```
